# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **GMV momentum accelerating** — Monthly eCat GMV averaged $3.7M over the last six full months (Oct 2025–Mar 2026), up 42% from the $2.6M average of May–Sep 2025, with March 2026 posting the year's highest single-month GMV at $4.0M. [→ §commerce]

2. **Quote workflow drives 73% of revenue** — Quote orders average $19,285 (nearly 2× the $9,856 proforma average) and contribute 73.1% of the $38.1M trailing-12-month GMV despite representing 58.7% of order volume. [→ §commerce]

3. **Customer base is well-diversified** — The top 5 buyers account for just 19.6% of eCat GMV with no single account exceeding 8%, providing strong resilience against individual customer churn. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **URGENCY**: Investigate the sharp AOV uplift (from ~$11K in summer 2025 to $18K–$24K in recent months) to determine whether it reflects a genuine product-mix shift toward higher-value specifications or a quoting/pricing anomaly that could distort conversion expectations [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
